requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: One study abroad term (at least nine units) as an exchange student at an SFU exchange partner or one full-time SFU field school program or an alternate approved full-time Study Abroad program.

requirements.text: Stream 2 students must also complete two additional language, international business, or global perspectives courses from the lists above.

grades.label: Grade Requirements
grades.text: In addition to normal university grade point average requirements, the Beedie School of Business requires a minimum 2.30 overall SFU Business course grade point average for entry into all 300 and 400 division business courses.

grades.label: Grade Requirements
grades.text: A minimum grade point average of 2.00 calculated on all courses applied towards the certificate is required for graduation from a business certificate.
